verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing lets developers create tightly scoped cards via transaction rules (merchant/amount limits) and real-time relayed authorization webhooks to approve/decline each transaction, plus per-card balance accounts for exact-amount funding — enabling developers to build single-use-like controls themselves. However, there is no explicit built-in 'single-use card' or auto-expire-after-one-use feature; achieving 'one purchase, one merchant, exact amount' relies on custom transaction rule logic and webhook responses rather than a native single-use card type. Missing for 10: explicit single-use card issuance capability, native auto-close-after-first-use mechanism, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this scoping works as claimed.
